snippet.title: Confined: Leaving OKB-134 - Official Demo Trailer | Upload VR Showcase Winter 2025
snippet.description: Here's your look at gameplay from Confined: Leaving OKB-134 in this new trailer for the upcoming horror/puzzle adventure game. Reactivate power, lights and complex machinery in this abandoned soviet bunker. Learn about long-gone personnel, solve riddles and find a way to escape. But stay quiet! You’re not alone. Confined: Leaving OKB-134 will be available on PC and Steam VR on March 4, 2026. A demo is out now.
